description: This file defines functions, macros, and templates for performing interpolation operations within a firmware project, including 2D and 3D interpolation, as well as a FastInterpolation class.

classes.name: FastInterpolation
classes.description: A class for linear interpolation between two points with methods to initialize and retrieve interpolated values.

methods.name: findIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of a given value within a sorted array.

methods.name: findIndexMsg
methods.description: Finds the index of a value within an array, with logging message.

methods.name: ensureArrayIsAscending
methods.description: Ensures that an array is sorted in ascending order, with error messaging.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Logs a warning message when an error condition occurs.

methods.name: cisnan
methods.description: Checks if a floating point number is NaN.

methods.name: printf
methods.description: Standard C function for formatted output.

methods.name: interpolate3d
methods.description: Performs 2D table lookup with linear interpolation across two axes.

methods.name: setCurveValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a curve given bins and values arrays.

methods.name: initInterpolation
methods.description: Initializes interpolation settings, potentially setting up logging.
